## 6247 N Rockwell St — Zoning & Development Assessment
**PIN:** 13012120030000 | **Parcel Resolution:** Authoritative

---

### 1. Zoning District

This parcel is zoned **RS-2 (Residential Single-Unit)** per the City's official GIS system. RS-2 is a standard single-family district permitting detached houses, parks, schools, religious institutions, and home occupations — no multi-family uses by right [1].

**Verify:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning)

---

### 2. Could You Build a Two-Flat?

**No — not by right.** The lot is 4,125 sq ft. RS-2 requires 5,000 sq ft minimum lot area per dwelling unit [1], so the arithmetic is: 4,125 ÷ 5,000 = 0.82 → **0 additional units** supportable on lot-area grounds alone. You cannot reach two units in RS-2 without a rezoning.

There is a limited RS3 exemption allowing a two-unit building at 1,500 sq ft/unit when 60%+ of the block face is improved with multi-unit buildings [1] — but this parcel is **RS-2**, not RS-3, so that exemption does not apply here.

**Verify:** [1] (§17-2-0303-A and -B)

---

### 3. Key Bulk & Density Standards

All figures come from the zoning table for RS-2 [1]:

| Standard | RS-2 Requirement |
|---|---|
| **FAR** | 0.65 |
| **Max Height** | 30 ft |
| **Min Lot Size** | 5,000 sq ft |
| **Min Lot Area/Unit** | 5,000 sq ft |
| **Permitted Uses** | Detached houses only |

**Setbacks** are governed by [2] for off-street parking location (20-ft front setback for parking); general building setbacks for RS districts are set in §17-2-0400 of the Zoning Ordinance, which was not retrieved in full here — confirm the exact side/rear setback dimensions via the Zoning Map or the Chicago Zoning Ordinance directly.

---

### 4. Overlays & Special Designations

- **Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) Zone** — This parcel falls within an ARO zone. The West Ridge community area has 6 ARO-related affordable housing projects totaling 324 units. Any qualifying residential development triggering ARO thresholds must comply with affordable unit requirements.
- **No Planned Development** — not in a PD.
- **No Landmark or Historic District** — not a Chicago Landmark, not in a local historic district, not on the National Register.
- **No Transit-Oriented Development (TOD) eligibility** — the nearest CTA rail is Morse (Red Line, ~1.71 miles) and the nearest Metra is Peterson/Ridge (Union Pacific North, ~1.04 miles). The parcel is not in a TOD area, so no parking reductions or transit-served benefits apply.
- **No ADU (Additional Dwelling Unit) Overlay** — this parcel is not in a designated ADU-Allowed RS Area [3][4], so coach house and conversion unit pre-certification is not available here by that pathway.
- **No Special Service Area (SSA)**, no Planned Manufacturing District, no Lakefront Protection, no Special District.
- **Flood Zone X** — Area of Minimal Flood Hazard; not a Special Flood Hazard Area. Flood insurance is not typically required.
- **No brownfield sites nearby.**

**Verify overlays:** [Chicago Zoning Map](https://gisapps.chicago.gov/ZoningMapWeb/?liab=1&config=zoning); ARO details via Chicago DPD.

---

### 5. Parking Requirement & Transit Reduction

Off-street parking for residential uses in RS districts must be located on the same zoning lot as the dwelling units served [2]. Parking is prohibited in side setbacks and within 20 feet of the front property line, except when accessed by a permitted driveway [2].

**No transit-related parking reduction is available** — the parcel is not TOD-eligible, and no `tod_benefits` apply. The existing property has a 1-car garage.

**Verify:** [2] (§17-10-0601)

---

### 6. Coach House / ADU?

**No — not available on this lot by the ADU ordinance pathway.** [4] allows coach houses and conversion units only in designated **Additional Dwelling Unit-Allowed RS Areas** [3][4], and this parcel is confirmed **not** in such an area (`in_adu_area: false`).

The general accessory structure rules [3] do permit accessory buildings in required rear setbacks up to 15 ft in height, and coach houses are capped at 22 ft — but a new coach house *dwelling unit* requires the ADU-Allowed RS Area designation [4], which this parcel lacks.

**Verify:** [3] (§17-9-0201-E, -F); [4] (§17-7-0570–0574)

---

### Confidence & What Could Not Be Determined

**High confidence:** Zoning class, FAR, max height, lot area per unit, overlay status, flood zone, TOD ineligibility, ADU ineligibility — all from authoritative city GIS and the zoning table.

**Not determined from retrieved text:** Exact building setback dimensions (front, side, rear) for RS-2 — §17-2-0400 was not retrieved. Confirm these directly in the Zoning Ordinance or with the Department of Planning & Development.

**Assessment data:** No assessed value or implied market value was available from Cook County for this parcel. The estimated annual property tax is **$7,247** (2024 rates), primarily to the Board of Education ($3,976), City of Chicago ($1,768), and Cook County ($428). The property benefits from both a Homeowner Exemption and a Senior Citizen Exemption, reducing the taxable EAV.
